institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: R-DHAP (rituximab/dexamethasone/high-dose cytarabine/cisplatin) salvage

premedications.name: Vigorous hydration
premedications.notes: for cisplatin nephroprotection, with magnesium/potassium replacement

supportiveCare: G-CSF support; plan stem-cell collection after a chemosensitive response
Steroid eye drops and cerebellar checks during high-dose cytarabine
monitoring: Response by PET before high-dose therapy + autologous transplant
Renal function (cisplatin - substitute carboplatin/oxaliplatin if impaired)

drugs.name: Cytarabine
drugs.notes: 2000 mg/m2 IV every 12 h for two doses on day 2 (high-dose ara-C). Reduce for age/renal impairment.

drugs.name: Cisplatin
drugs.notes: 100 mg/m2 by continuous IV infusion over 24 h on day 1.
